name: Santa Fe Spring 2018
information: New Mexico's first competition in two years! Hooray! All competitors are expected to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competing. This competition's prizes have been provided by [Cube Depot](https://cubedepotusa.com/). The competition is open to the public, and we welcome spectators at no charge.
